changes.text: `saccade.act` may authorize a bounded continuous run only from one current `reflex_target` object carrying the current loop-class authority. The Node Broker, under the original request deadline and cancellation identity, repeatedly selects only current same-document targets with the same loop class, dispatches each exact current action token once, and requires the safe occurrence to advance before continuing. Pre-dispatch stale work may be skipped; any ambiguous or occurrence-unverified dispatch stops the loop with `outcome_unknown` and is never replayed. The report is bounded and value-free. This adds no seventh tool, Agent polling, arbitrary coordinate authority, native backend, or Rust route.
